\caption{Tier-4 synthetic 8-stage sparse DAG interdiction (200 graphs/family, $\sim 7.6$M--$8.4$M pathways; \texttt{interdiction.json}). \textbf{(a,b)} On narrow-waist DAGs ($w=6$, $N=300$ Boltzmann reports), reported-subgraph Dinic min-cut blocks 94.6\% and completely severs 73.5\% of graphs at $B=6$, whereas route-specific patching severs $0\%$ even at $B=32$. \textbf{(c)} On wide DAGs ($w=27$), reported min-cuts rarely sever the full graph even at $N=3{,}000$, showing that structural bottlenecks are necessary for compact gating.}\label{fig:v3interdiction}\end{figure*}
